[PR-EVAL][PR8-F0001][MAJOR][OPEN][DoD r1]
**Classification:** Confirmed in-scope defect; full PR classification remains INCOMPLETE until mandatory coverage and three clean discovery passes are certified.
**Defect / actual failure:** In the integrated opt-in ANVIL playback path, the native player labels its left/right compare pane **SOURCE** even though that pane displays `rawPresentationImage()` generated from the decoded frame **after** `LiveFrameProcessor::process(df,...)` has replaced its pixels. The UI also states “ANVIL reconstruction ... [is] not yet connected,” while the same merged PR connects an opt-in causal ANVIL processing stage. This conflates the original decoded source with the causal-ANVIL control and hides an active experimental mode from a reviewer. The separate authenticated reviewer correctly labels its causal control, but it does not repair the native UI's identity.
**Evidence at HEAD:** `19e9591723151c3dea27d5039a70f6a1e3c15daf`. `src/core/PlaybackEngine.cpp:2924-2946` mutates `df` ahead of FSR upload, `:1834-1845` exposes uploader's `rawPresentationImage` via `fsr4RawOutput`, `src/ui/VideoSurfaceItem.cpp:96-130` renders that image for `rawOnly`, and `resources/qml/Main.qml:202-229,344-392` labels it SOURCE. `resources/qml/SettingsDialog.qml` Upscaler subtitle says reconstruction is not yet connected. This is a deterministic source/data-flow inconsistency; a live visual reproduction has not yet been executed independently.
**Violated requirement:** Unified PR #8 composition (functional ANVIL pre-FSR live stage + “honest” player UI), `docs/current/ANVIL_LIVE_PIPELINE.md` active opt-in processing, and `docs/current/PLAYER_UI.md` truthful descriptions and comparison state.
**Root cause and impact:** The old player's raw-vs-output semantics were inherited into a post-ANVIL processing chain without updating source identity. The comparison can mislead an experimenter into judging the input source instead of an ANVIL-reconstructed control, and the Settings text inaccurately describes the availability of the opt-in path.
**Definition of Done — DoD r1 (frozen):**
- [ ] **AC-01:** When opt-in ANVIL processing is active, each native A/B comparison label must identify the actual pixel-generation stage; the label SOURCE is valid only if the pane genuinely displays original, unmodified decoded pixels. **Falsifier:** an ANVIL-modified `rawPresentationImage` is displayed under a bare SOURCE label. **Proof:** trace image-producing/upload/rendering paths and independently inspect native UI during opt-in playback of an actually reconstructed frame.
- [ ] **AC-02:** Native settings and status text must accurately state when the causal ANVIL live stage is available/active, while distinguishing the incomplete full ANVIL roster. **Falsifier:** UI claims no ANVIL reconstruction is connected while `ANVIL_LIVE_PRE_FSR=1` has engaged a real stage. **Proof:** inspect user-visible wording and exercise both default-off and opt-in playback states.
- [ ] **AC-03:** A regression must ensure that the native compare controls cannot silently conflate the original source and post-ANVIL control when the opt-in stage is enabled. **Falsifier:** tests cover only the separate browser reviewer, not the native comparison and status state. **Proof:** execute a focused native QML/UI integration or equivalent behavioral test with distinct unprocessed and reconstructed pixels.
**Required re-review:** Verify all three ACs at a new exact head, inspect rendering/metadata contracts, and confirm no label regression in default-off player and standalone pair reviewer.
**Status:** OPEN. Do not equate a green general CTest/Python suite with proof that native A/B labels are truthful under the new integrated stage.

[PR-EVAL][PR8-F0001][RE-REVIEW][HEAD 205fe7e077da4332a175b77a07219df4cc4c3986][DoD r1]
**Status: OPEN (source-level partial repair, not fixed_verified).** The repair's published `PATCHED_PROVISIONAL` is not an independent evaluator verdict. Frozen DoD r1 and checksum `279c8849c4feb544c62ff70d8f3d9912f85807209938c7cdf28fe37ff7187d3c` remain unchanged. Original: https://github.com/Rolaand-Jayz/Temporal-Forge-ANVIL/pull/8#issuecomment-6157506067 .

**AC-01 — FAILED (source-level counterexample; native reproduction still pending).** The new `rawPaneStageLabel()` reads `playback.anvilLiveStage` and switches SOURCE/POST-ANVIL, but the state is published by the **decode thread immediately after** `LiveFrameProcessor::process(df,...)` at `src/core/PlaybackEngine.cpp:2944–2950`, before the frame's Vulkan upload, GPU dispatch, presentation scaler and `fsr4PublishedUploader_` swap. `fsr4RawOutput()` at :1834–1845 and the native `VideoSurfaceItem` render path still use the *last successfully published uploader*, not the most recently processed decoded frame. A concrete falsifier: frame N publishes with reconstructed pixels (should read POST-ANVIL); frame N+1 is unsupported/discontinuous/budget-bypassed (tracker immediately changes to standby/bypassed, so QML reports SOURCE); before N+1 is published—or if upload/dispatch fails and the prior output remains displayed—the SOURCE label can accompany N's post-ANVIL image. The inverse mismatch is also possible when processing a new reconstructed frame before its output is published. Neither the status atomic nor `anvilLiveStageChanged` is tied to the published GPU image/frame identity. This is a deterministic ordering flaw in source; time-window duration and actual on-screen reproduction are NOT independently measured.
**AC-02 — UNVERIFIED (text corrected).** `resources/qml/SettingsDialog.qml` now correctly describes an opt-in causal live stage vs incomplete full roster and shows `off`/`standby`/`reconstructing`/`bypassed`; `LiveHud.qml` is also wired. But displayed-frame-relative state accuracy and manual off/on inspection are not proven, and the same early-published status can misdescribe the visible image.
**AC-03 — FAILED / proof incomplete.** `tests/anvil_live_frame_tests.cpp` now tests real distinct reconstructed pixels and isolated `LiveStageTracker` transitions, and `tests/test_player_ui_contract.py` asserts QML source strings. Neither associates status/labels with the **actually published** VkImage across delayed/failed dispatch, so the exact AC-01 falsifier passes these tests.
**Exact-head CI:** https://github.com/Rolaand-Jayz/Temporal-Forge-ANVIL/actions/runs/38584217028 — Release Arch CTest 35 run/0 fail (2 skip; 4 disabled), including active negative-control and paired capture CTests; Python 143 passed. These checks validate existing assertions but not publication-order ownership.
**Required re-review (unchanged AC-01/02/03):** Pair producer stage identity with the frame whose image is actually published; independently exercise interleaved `Reconstructed → Unsupported/Discontinuity/OverBudget`, delayed GPU dispatch and forced upload/presentation failure with a prior reconstructed frame still displayed; assert both native pane label and HUD/settings track displayed-frame ownership. Validate default-off, fallback and opt-in on real Qt/AMD hardware. Existing original acceptance requirements remain the sole finish line.
**No new finding ID**: same native comparison misattribution/root-cause class as `PR8-F0001`. No source edits, approve, merge or thread disposition by evaluator.

[PR-EVAL][PR8-F0002][MAJOR][OPEN][DoD r1]
**Classification:** INCOMPLETE review; confirmed in-scope source-level defect. Independent native reproduction remains outstanding.
**Defect / actual failure:** With FSR4 disabled, Vulkan playback defaults to **EASU-only**. The A/B control remains enabled, but `fsr4RawOutput()` returns false because `fsr4Ready_` is false for this path. The raw-only `VideoSurfaceItem` falls back to its **enhanced EASU native texture** when `m_rawTexture` is null. The left/right raw pane therefore depicts the same processed output instead of decoded SOURCE, despite the `SOURCE` label. If a cached raw texture exists from another mode, the renderer can instead use stale input. This undermines the native comparison baseline even with ANVIL opt-in disabled.
**Evidence at HEAD:** `1882627c3a7e0fe9a8ce3782210db135084afef9`; `src/core/PlaybackEngine.cpp:1225-1276` defaults FSR-off/Vulkan to EASU-only, `:1783-1816` exports EASU image as native output, `:1834-1847` rejects raw image when FSR4 is not ready; `resources/qml/Main.qml:218-247,317-348,728-736` instantiates a `rawOnly` pane, labels it SOURCE and permits compare whenever media exists; `src/ui/VideoSurfaceItem.cpp:94-147,178-195` selects native output when `rawOnly` has no raw texture. **Observed by static source tracing; no live Qt render reproduced.**
**Violated requirement:** `docs/current/PLAYER_UI.md` Design rules: truthful comparison source/stage, functional A/B control; PR #8 SCOPE-03 and unified user-facing integration.
**Root cause and impact:** EASU-only output and raw image access use inconsistent readiness/ownership gates; raw-only rendering silently displays the processed output or retained texture instead of failing closed. Distinct from PR8-F0001, which governs decoder-vs-post-ANVIL stage identity during successful native/FSR publication.
**Definition of Done — DoD r1 (frozen):**
- [ ] **AC-01:** When compare is available in EASU-only mode, the pane labeled SOURCE displays decoder-owned pixels of the corresponding published frame, or a truthful post-ANVIL control if reconstruction modified those pixels. **Falsifier:** an EASU-upscaled output or a previous frame appears under SOURCE. **Proof:** trace EASU image and raw-source publication/accessor/Qt consumer; run a native EASU-only A/B session with intentionally distinct source/output frames.
- [ ] **AC-02:** Raw-only rendering must not silently substitute processed output or stale cached input whenever a valid paired raw texture is unavailable. **Falsifier:** `rawOnly: true` renders native output or an unrelated prior raw frame after raw accessor failure. **Proof:** exercise missing/failed raw image, switching FSR4/EASU, and cache invalidation/recovery.
- [ ] **AC-03:** Native automated/behavioral regression covers EASU-only comparison authenticity, both swap orientations, and default-off plus opt-in stage labeling without replacing runtime proof with QML string assertions. **Falsifier:** tests pass while both compare panes use processed EASU output. **Proof:** targeted source-to-present behavior verification using distinct raw/EASU pixels plus manual Qt/Vulkan inspection.
**Required re-review:** Re-evaluate the actual EASU-only/raw-only output path and exact-head CI + GPU/UI evidence, including transitions from FSR4 neural mode. **Status: OPEN.** Do not merge on a green general CI result.
